description: An inline-block of blocks: its width is its widest block, and the text around it sits on its last line.

florui.css: .p { width: 280px; background-color: #e8ecff; color: #112233; } .b { display: inline-block; background-color: #fff2b8; }

classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 153 on Windows: 3.05% of the pixels differ and the box is within 1px; what is left is the two engines' glyph antialiasing, as in the other text fixtures. Without the feature the same fixture measures 69.41% and the box is 44.0px off, so it fails.
